subject: Natural Language Generation
source_sentence: Natural Language Generation , NLG, is often viewed as a complex process comprising four main tasks : i) macro planning, building an overall text plan; ii) micro planning, se- lecting referring expressions and appropriate content words; iii) surface realisation, selection of gram- matical constructions and linear order; and iv) phys- ical presentation, producing final articulation and layout operations.
